learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to discover your body's superpowers by learning about strength, speed, and how to become a super-fit champion!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Motor fitness is like upgrading your body's engine! It is the secret recipe of speed, strength, and balance that helps you run faster, jump higher, and play longer without getting tired.
Have you ever played tag for a long time? Endurance is your body's battery pack. The more you exercise, the bigger your battery gets, letting you have fun for hours!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🤸‍♀️ Bend It Like a Rubber Band
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Flexibility means how well you can stretch and bend. Doing daily stretches keeps your muscles happy and prevents you from getting hurt when you play.

fun_activity.title: 🐆 The Animal Walk Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Try moving around your room like different animals for 3 minutes! Do a bear crawl for strength, hop like a frog for power, and stretch tall like a giraffe for flexibility.

quick_recap: ⭐ Motor fitness combines speed, strength, endurance, agility, and flexibility.
⭐ Having good endurance helps you play your favorite games longer without feeling tired.
⭐ Stretching every day keeps your muscles super flexible and safe from injuries.
